title: Zero- and Finite-Temperature Casimir Effect in a Fracton Gauge Field
summary: We investigate the zero- and finite-temperature Casimir interaction of the free trace-full scalar-charge fracton gauge field between two parallel reflecting boundaries. A variational analysis determines a consistent boundary-value problem that confines all five physical polarizations of the rank-two field. The spectrum separates into three faster and two slower propagating modes.
